title.en: GELU, GLU variants, and SwiGLU width
title.zh: GELU、GLU 变体与 SwiGLU 宽度

en.a: The feed-forward sublayer is the pointwise nonlinear write that follows attention, and its activation/gating choice changes the block's parameter allocation.
en.b: The FFN transforms each prefix-conditioned residual representation independently at a position, so it changes the conditional map without introducing a new cross-position dependency.

zh.a: 前馈子层是紧随注意力机制之后的逐点非线性写入，其激活/门控选择会改变块的参数分配。
zh.b: FFN 在位置处独立转换每个前缀条件化的残差表示，因此它改变了条件映射，而不会引入新的跨位置依赖。
